description_en: Queries the member credit consumption ranking for a single workspace under the caller's account within a specified time range. Returns one aggregated record per member covering the entire range, paginated and sorted by total credits in descending order, without bucketing by hour or day. The total count for pagination is the number of members matching the filter criteria, not the number of metering records. To view individual records, call `ListContextDatabaseCreditUsageRecords`
description_zh: 查询调用方账号下单个 Workspace 在指定时间区间内的成员 Credit 消耗排名。每个成员返回一条覆盖整个区间的汇总记录，按 Credit 合计从高到低分页返回，不按小时或天分桶。分页总数为符合筛选条件的成员数，不是计量记录数。查看逐条记录请调用 `ListContextDatabaseCreditUsageRecords`
name: GetContextDatabaseCreditUsageSummaryByMember

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query interval, inclusive. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z` (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的开始时间，包含该时刻。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`（UTC）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query interval, exclusive. It must be later than `StartTime`. Use the ISO 8601 time format, such as `2026-10-08T00:00:00Z` (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的结束时间，不包含该时刻，必须晚于 `StartTime`。使用 ISO 8601 时间格式，例如 `2026-10-08T00:00:00Z`（UTC）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to be analyzed. This parameter is required. The workspace must belong to the caller's account. Locked workspaces can still be queried. Member IDs are unique only within their respective workspaces, and cross-workspace ranking is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 要统计的 Workspace ID，必填。该 Workspace 必须属于调用方账号，已锁定时也可查询。成员 ID 只在所属 Workspace 内唯一，不支持跨 Workspace 排名
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The member ID used to filter the aggregated results. If specified, only this member is analyzed without changing the caller identity. An empty list is returned if no matching records are found
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选汇总结果的成员 ID。指定时只统计该成员，不改变调用身份；没有匹配记录时返回空列表
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The billing item used to filter records. Supported values include KnowledgeBaseRead (knowledge base read), MemoryRead (memory read), MemoryWrite (memory write), KnowledgeBaseWriteToken (knowledge base write token), and ContextGrowth (context growth). If omitted, all billing items that consume credits are included. Specifying storage items or unlisted values returns an `InvalidParameter` error
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选记录的计费项。支持 KnowledgeBaseRead（知识库读取）、MemoryRead（记忆库读取）、MemoryWrite（记忆库写入）、KnowledgeBaseWriteToken（知识库写入 Token）、ContextGrowth（上下文演进）。省略时包含全部消耗 Credit 的计费项；存储项或未列出的值会返回 `InvalidParameter`
parameters.name: item

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of members to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的成员数，取值范围为 1～200，默认值为 50
parameters.name: page_size

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query interval passed in the request, exclusive
EndTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间结束时间，不包含该时刻

Items.description_en: The member summaries on the current page, sorted by total credit consumption in descending order. Each record covers the entire query interval
Items.description_zh: 当前页的成员汇总，按 Credit 消耗合计从高到低排列。每条记录覆盖整个查询区间

Credits.description_en: The total credit consumption of priced records for this member. Returned as a decimal string with up to 6 decimal places, where 1 credit = 1 CNY. The value is `null` if there are no priced records
Credits.description_zh: 该成员已定价记录的 Credit 消耗合计。以十进制字符串返回，最多 6 位小数；1 Credit = 1 元人民币。 没有已定价记录时为 `null`

MemberId.description_en: The member ID. Historical or system records may not have a member ID
MemberId.description_zh: 成员 ID。历史或系统记录可能没有成员 ID

Quantity.description_en: The total metered quantity of records that match the filter criteria for this member, including unpriced records. To view the usage of a specific billing item, specify `Item` in the request
Quantity.description_zh: 该成员符合筛选条件的记录的计量数量合计，包含未定价记录。查看某一计费项的用量时，可在请求中指定 `Item`

RecordCount.description_en: The number of metering records that match the filter criteria for this member, including unpriced records
RecordCount.description_zh: 该成员符合筛选条件的计量记录数，包含未定价记录

Page.description_en: The actual page number used in this query
Page.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的页码

PageSize.description_en: The actual number of items per page used in this query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询实际使用的每页条数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the OpenAPI request, used to troubleshoot call issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 请求的 ID，用于定位调用问题

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query interval passed in the request, inclusive
StartTime.description_zh: 请求中传入的查询区间开始时间，包含该时刻

Total.description_en: The total number of members that match the filter criteria. This is not the number of metering records and is not affected by pagination
Total.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的成员总数，不是计量记录数，不受分页影响

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace queried in this request
